summary: Planban 1.0.1 hardens in-app browser opening, installed-cache runtime discovery, detached server startup, and filesystem watching for large board histories.
updatePrompt: Install or update Planban from piercekearns/planban, follow the public GitHub README, verify the plugin and MCP tools are available, then open Planban in the Codex in-app browser.
changelogSummary: Planban now opens reliably with the current Codex Browser runtime, launches correctly from installed plugin caches, stays healthy with large history volumes, and reports detached-launch failures more clearly.
